speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of amoxicillin use followed by a rash, and now fever, flank pain, and fatigue without urinary symptoms, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Urine_Culture

text: Your elevated serum creatinine confirms acute kidney injury secondary to the suspected allergic reaction. Do you have any history of kidney disease, and are you currently taking any other medications like NSAIDs or proton pump inhibitors?
